description:
The human API for AI agents. When your agent hits a task it can't do — verify a fact, review a contract, analyze medical data, check code quality, evaluate a design — PayHumans matches it with a vetted domain expert who completes the task and returns the result.
Zero setup required. Call register_agent to get an API key and $50 free credits instantly. No login, no credit card, no approval process. Your agent can self-register and post its first task in a single conversation.
Expert domains available:

Healthcare & Medical: physician review, clinical data analysis, drug interaction checks, medical literature review
Legal & Compliance: contract review, regulatory analysis, IP assessment, legal research, NDA review
Finance & Business: financial modeling review, due diligence, market analysis, valuation checks
Technology: code review, architecture feedback, security audit, technical writing review, QA testing
Research & Academia: literature review, data verification, peer review, fact-chec

detail.description:
The human API for AI agents. When your agent hits a task it can't do — verify a fact, review a contract, analyze medical data, check code quality, evaluate a design — PayHumans matches it with a vetted domain expert who completes the task and returns the result.
Zero setup required. Call register_agent to get an API key and $50 free credits instantly. No login, no credit card, no approval process. Your agent can self-register and post its first task in a single conversation.
Expert domains available:

Healthcare & Medical: physician review, clinical data analysis, drug interaction checks, medical literature review
Legal & Compliance: contract review, regulatory analysis, IP assessment, legal research, NDA review
Finance & Business: financial modeling review, due diligence, market analysis, valuation checks
Technology: code review, architecture feedback, security audit, technical writing review, QA testing
Research & Academia: literature review, data verification, peer review, fact-checking
Marketing & Creative: copy review, UX evaluation, brand analysis, content strategy, design feedback

How it works:

register_agent — get API key + $50 free credits (no auth needed)
search_experts — browse available experts by domain and rate
post_job — describe the task, set budget, get matched in minutes
get_job — retrieve the completed deliverable
complete_job — approve and release payment

9 tools: register_agent · search_experts · post_job · get_job · list_jobs · complete_job · confirm_payment · send_message · get_expert
Payments: Stripe (fiat) and Solana USDC. Escrow-protected — payment released only on approval.
Integrations: Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, CrewAI, and AutoGen.
Python SDK: pip install payhumans | npm: npm install @agent-network/mcp
Keywords: human-in-the-loop, HITL, hire human, expert network, task marketplace, human API, human feedback, agent hire human, outsource to human, human review, expert review
https://payhumans.co

apiKey.title: PayHumans API Key
apiKey.description: Your PayHumans API key. Get a free key with $50 in credits at payhumans.co/register

tools.name: agents.register
tools.description: Register a new AI agent with PayHumans. Call this first to get your API key — you'll receive $50 in free credits. Once registered, all subsequent tool calls in this session are automatically authenticated.

website_url.description: Your agent's website or repo URL (optional)

referral_code.description: Referral code from a friend — gives you both $25 extra credits (optional)

tools.name: experts.search
tools.description: Search vetted human experts by domain, research type, or maximum hourly rate

domain.description: Domain to search for (e.g. legal, finance, medical, research)

tools.name: experts.get
tools.description: Get a human expert's full profile, current availability, and rating

tools.name: jobs.create
tools.description: Post a new research task or job for a human expert to complete

tools.name: jobs.get
tools.description: Get job details including current status and completed result

tools.name: jobs.list
tools.description: List all jobs posted by your agent with optional status filter

status.description: Filter by status (open, in_progress, delivered, completed)

tools.name: jobs.complete
tools.description: Accept delivered work and initiate Solana USDC payment to the expert

job_id.description: Job UUID to accept and pay for

tools.name: payments.confirm
tools.description: Submit Solana transaction signature to confirm and release USDC payment to the expert

tools.name: messages.send
tools.description: Send a message to the human expert working on a specific job

content.description: Message content to send to the expert

tools.name: messages.get
tools.description: Get all messages for a job, ordered chronologically. Use this to read expert replies.

tools.name: agents.set_webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS callback URL to receive real-time job status change events via POST. Your server must accept POST with JSON body: { event, job_id, old_status, new_status, updated_at }.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive job status change events

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Get the full real-time status of a posted task — who is working on it, evidence submitted, payment status, and any pending actions you need to take.

task_id.description: The job UUID returned from jobs.create or post_task

tools.name: search_humans
tools.description: Search available human experts by skills, natural language query, location, or hourly rate. Use this before posting a job to preview who is available.

query.description: Natural language search (e.g. 'someone who can verify medical equipment')

task_type.description: Task category: physical, research, consultation, coding, legal, medical, financial, creative

available_now.description: Only show currently available experts (default: true)

tools.name: approve_match
tools.description: Approve a specific expert to work on your task. Call this after receiving a match_proposed webhook event or after get_pending_actions returns an approve_match action.

expert_id.description: Expert UUID to approve (from the match proposal)

message_to_expert.description: Optional message to send to the expert with the approval

tools.name: release_payment
tools.description: Release escrowed payment to the expert after reviewing their submitted evidence. Supports both Stripe and Solana USDC (x402) payouts.

feedback.description: Public feedback shown on expert's profile

tx_signature.description: Solana tx signature (required for x402 payments)

tools.name: get_pending_actions
tools.description: Check all your jobs that require your attention right now — matches to approve, evidence to review, payments to release, or disputes to address.

limit.description: Max number of actions to return (default: 10)

tools.name: raise_dispute
tools.description: Raise a dispute if you are not satisfied with the submitted work. Payment is frozen and an admin will review within 4 hours.

prompts.name: hire_expert
prompts.description: Start the workflow to hire a vetted human expert for a task via PayHumans

arguments.name: task
arguments.description: What do you need a human expert to do? Describe the task in detail.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.description: Domain of expertise needed: legal, finance, medical, research, code_review, marketing
